errors.description: The final exponential-divisibility characterization is not valid as stated: for primes absent from all initial numbers, arbitrary positive exponents divide every zero valuation, so no unique maximal integer exists without an additional restriction on prime support.
errors.quote: the unique maximal $d$ with $v_p(d) \mid v_p(a_i)$ for all $p$ and all $i$.

parsed.notes: The actual proof is complete and correct. Termination follows from the product/number-of-ones potential, and the prime-wise gcd of valuations is correctly invariant and uniquely determines the terminal value.
